title: Throughput Measurement — Board I
purpose: First board allowed to compare S206 Wave 1 operational data against S350 targets. Measure throughput gain, review reduction, board reduction, and artifact reuse. Be honest: scan throughput is measured; certification throughput cannot yet be measured (no v2 wave has run).

key_metrics.TE-005_remaining_uncertified: 469 at S202 baseline. Reduced to 319 by S322.

s206_wave_1_throughput.context: S206 is a read-only Framework v2 operational session using the scan pipeline. It does NOT include content certification throughput (no certification wave ran). All measurements are scan-pipeline only.

BF-007_identity_ambiguity.v1_value: PRESENT — binary_fail. ~75% false-positive rate from forward-scan.
BF-007_identity_ambiguity.s206_observed: ELIMINATED — 99.96% identity resolution. 0% false-positive rate. Line-level extraction methodology eliminates DL-020 and DL-029 error classes. VERIFIED: 2,539/2,540 PASS.
BF-007_identity_ambiguity.gain: QUALITATIVE_ELIMINATION — from a documented failure condition (wrong-target remediation, S320-class failures) to operational prevention.
BF-007_identity_ambiguity.confidence: HIGH — measured with production scan data

BF-009_defect_timing_shift_left.s206_observed: 78% pre-flight (target) NOT YET ACHIEVED — scan pipeline is operational (0.7s, 2,540 items) but scans are advisory, not enforcement. 0% of defects are actually detected pre-flight because no certification wave has entered the pipeline.
BF-009_defect_timing_shift_left.infrastructure_readiness: OPERATIONAL — the pipeline detects defects (DL-008:3, DL-026:274, DL-013:31, EV3:2,074 at S206). The detection infrastructure is proven. The enforcement gap is governance, not technical.
BF-009_defect_timing_shift_left.gain: INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY — proven but not yet operationalized. First measurable pre-flight detection rate requires S811 v2 certification wave.

BF-001_agents_per_session.s206_observed: ~8-12 (read-only analytics session — does not include content-certification agent spawns). Not comparable.
BF-001_agents_per_session.blocker: Requires a v2 certification wave to measure agent-spawn reduction from pre-flight gating, delta review, and board consolidation.

BF-005_duplicate_review_cycles.blocker: Requires a v2 certification wave with delta review operational to measure.

BF-006_re_review_rate.s206_observed: 100% (baseline artifact — all items need review because no prior certification exists)
BF-006_re_review_rate.blocker: Requires second certification wave for delta comparison. First measurable at S811→S812.

TH-009_throughput_multiplier.s206_observed: 1.0× (v1 operations continue — no v2 certification wave)
TH-009_throughput_multiplier.blocker: All throughput multiplier gains come from: pre-flight gating (saves board-review time), delta review (eliminates re-review), board consolidation (8→5 reduces overhead). None of these are operational in enforcement mode.

throughput_gain_decomposition.description: What gains CAN we measure today? What gains require future sessions?

measurable_today.v1_baseline: ~10.75 hours (estimated) for per-defect-class manual grep-based scanning across 50+ events
measurable_today.v2_measured: 0.7s for full-pipeline scan of all defect classes simultaneously

measurable_today.multiplier: INFINITE — eliminates the entire error class

measurable_today.v1_baseline: 0% reuse (every session performed its own ad-hoc scan)

measurable_today.v2_measured: 2 structured artifacts, 100% consumption rate, all consumed by downstream analytics
measurable_today.multiplier: Quality shift from ad-hoc reports to structured, consumable artifacts

measurable_today.v1_baseline: 4-5 sessions per certification wave. Much of this was scanning and re-scanning (duplicate review, identity disputes).
measurable_today.v2_measured: 0.7s for all scanning. S206 (read-only operational) took ~5-10 min. The scanning overhead has been eliminated — certification sessions can now focus entirely on content review.
measurable_today.multiplier: Qualitative — scanning overhead dropped from hours to sub-second, but certification decision time (the actual bottleneck) hasn't yet been measured in v2.

requires_future_sessions.depends_on: S811 (first v2 certification wave). Gate -1 through Gate 4 must be enforcement (not advisory). Items with BLOCKED or REMEDIATE status must be excluded from Certification Board queue.
Second scan artifact with content changes (S811→S812 or similar). At least one content-modifying session between baseline scans.
requires_future_sessions.first_measurable_at: S812 or second scan after S811 writes content changes

requires_future_sessions.depends_on: Certification boards must adopt the 5-board v2 model. Current certification sessions still operate with 8 boards (v1).
requires_future_sessions.first_measurable_at: First v2 certification wave adopting the 5-board model

requires_future_sessions.depends_on: All above gains combined into a single certification wave.
requires_future_sessions.first_measurable_at: S811 through S813 (complete v2 certification cycle)

current_status.delta_review: CLASSIFICATION ENGINE READY — requires comparison data

s350_throughput_multiplier_reality_check.verdict: 3.8× TARGET IS ARCHITECTURALLY SOUND — each component is specified, validated, and infrastructure-ready. But 0% of the multiplier has been realized because no v2 certification wave has run. The 0.7s scan is the only operational gain. The 3.8× requires: (a) enforcement-mode gates, (b) at least 2 certification waves for delta comparison, (c) board model adoption. All three are scheduled for S811+.

verdict: THROUGHPUT_PARTIALLY_MEASURABLE — Scan throughput is massive and verified (0.7s vs. ~10.75 hours estimated v1 scanning, ~55,000× improvement). Scan accuracy is categorically better (0% false positives vs. ~75% in v1). Artifact reuse is proven (1 scan → 32 board consumptions). However, certification throughput — the metric that matters for delivery velocity — CANNOT be measured because no v2 certification wave has run. The infrastructure is proven operational; the throughput gains are projected at 1.5-3.8× but 0% have been realized. S811 is the first opportunity to measure actual certification throughput under v2.
